occupation: regular academic/research position in a recognized institution
other_conditions: Applicant must be an Indian citizen residing in India
Applicant must hold a regular academic or research position in a recognized institution
Proposals may be submitted by an individual or by a team of investigators
If submitted by a team, a Principal Investigator must be identified to lead the research and administer the grant
benefits_summary: No budget limit; the grant covers equipment, consumables, travel, contingency and overhead expenses.
